description: Customize your NVDA startup and exit sounds. Choose from a built-in sound pack, import community packs, use your own WAV file, set a startup delay, control volume, set silent hours, and use schedule or random mode.
changelog:
# 2.1.1

* Confirmed compatibility with NVDA 2026.3

# 2.1.0

* Per-event volume control for startup and exit sounds
* Silent Hours: set a do-not-disturb window where no sound plays
* Random mode no longer repeats the same sound twice in a row
